summary_en: This phase 2 study tests risk-adapted systemic therapy guided by the PROphet CB proteomic assay and the CARG-TT assessment, compared with standard biomarker testing followed by standard first-line treatment, in people with previously untreated advanced non-small cell lung cancer. The trial chooses the immune checkpoint inhibitor-based treatment according to the PROphet CB and CARG-TT results, and how it is given and for how long are not stated. The main outcome is 12-month progression-free survival.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa un tratamiento sistémico adaptado al riesgo, guiado por la prueba proteómica PROphet CB y la evaluación CARG-TT, comparado con la prueba estándar de biomarcadores seguida del tratamiento estándar de primera línea, en personas con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado que no han recibido tratamiento sistémico previo. El estudio elige el tratamiento a base de inhibidores de puntos de control inmunitarios según los resultados de PROphet CB y CARG-TT; la forma de administración y la duración no se indican. El resultado principal es la supervivencia libre de progresión a los 12 meses.
who_for: Histologically confirmed non-small cell lung cancer that is metastatic or unresectable (stage IIIC or IV).
Age 18 years or older at the time of consent.
ECOG performance status 2 or better (Karnofsky 50% or higher).
Able to understand and sign the informed consent form.
Stated ability and willingness to follow all protocol requirements.
not_for: Tumor with a known sensitizing change in ALK, EGFR, HER2, MET exon 14, NTRK, RET, or ROS1.
Medical conditions that rule out immune checkpoint inhibitor-based therapy, per the treating investigator.
Prior systemic therapy for metastatic stage IIIC or IV non-small cell lung cancer.
Any condition the investigator judges would interfere with safety or ability to comply with the study.
